name: Arrhenius’s carbon dioxide climate calculation
description: Arrhenius calculated how atmospheric carbon dioxide changes could affect surface temperatures, including an ice-age cooling scenario.

caveats: The historical scenario-specific estimate is not a modern climate-sensitivity result. Earlier work on gases and climate should not be collapsed into this calculation. The 1896 publication identifies an 1895 presentation, but the surviving extract alone does not establish which numerical results were included in that presentation.
